sloka: सर्वथा कृतकार्यो ऽसौ हनूमान्नात्र संशयः ।न ह्यस्याकृतकार्यस्य नाद एवंविधो भवेत् ।। 5.57.24 ।।।।
transliteration: sarvathā kṛtakāryo 'sau hanūmānnātra saṁśayaḥ ।na hyasyākṛtakāryasya nāda evaṁvidho bhavet ।। 5.57.24 ।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the sound of his dashing movements of arms and thighs the vanaras jumped about in joy, then and there.
